title: bug: moe-agent.ps1 agent git guard fails under PS 5.1 when TEMP contains a space
description:
Initialize-MoeAgentGitGuard runs `& node - $projectPath ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath())`. GetTempPath() ends in `\`, and PS 5.1 quotes a native argument that holds a space as `"C:\x y\tmp\"`, so node gets `C:\x y\tmp"`. mkdtemp then throws, the seat logs MOE_AGENT_GIT_GUARD_FAILED and no CLI ever launches. PS 7.6 passes the argument intact.
Repro: run worktree-landing.ps1 with TMP/TEMP = `C:\...\c1 x\tmp`, or under PS 5.1 run `& node -e "console.log(process.argv)" 'C:\a b\tmp\'`, which prints `C:\a b\tmp"`. Found by WT-08T (task-c12f9463), which now keeps TMP space-free to avoid it.
